articles.abstract_en: We develop and test a model of social duties. The model distinguishes unconditional duties to take or avoid certain actions from conditional duties that depend on the actions’ payoffs. It also distinguishes strict duties (must do) from liberal duties (ought to do). The disutility associated with duty violation depends on the duty’s strictness and is proportional to the externality the violation causes. The model rationalizes behavioral patterns that are incompatible with consequentialist preferences. Our tests comprise parameter estimation based on subjects’ behavior across different situations as well as measurement of duties through spectators’ appropriateness ratings.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发并测试社会责任模型。该模型将采取或避免某些行动的无条件义务与取决于行动收益的有条件义务区分开来。它还区分了严格的义务（必须做）和自由的义务（应该做）。与违反义务相关的负效用取决于义务的严格程度，并与违反行为造成的外部性成正比。该模型合理化了与结果主义偏好不相容的行为模式。我们的测试包括根据受试者在不同情况下的行为进行参数估计，以及通过观众的适当性评级来衡量职责。

articles.title_en: The Causal Effects of Youth Cigarette Addiction and Education
articles.title_cn: 青少年吸烟成瘾与教育的因果关系
articles.abstract_en: We develop and estimate a life-cycle model of addiction in which forward-looking youth choose to smoke, attend school, work part-time, and consume while facing borrowing constraints. The model features multiple channels for studying the reciprocal causal effects of addiction and education. Variations in endowments and cigarette prices are sources of identification. We show that education causally reduces smoking. A counterfactual experiment finds that in the absence of cigarette smoking, college attendance increases by 2 percentage points in the population. An alternative 25% additional excise tax achieves similar results. Impacts vary substantially across persons of different cognitive and noncognitive abilities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发并估计了一个成瘾的生命周期模型，其中有远见的年轻人在面临借贷限制的情况下选择吸烟、上学、兼职工作和消费。该模型具有多种渠道来研究成瘾和教育的相互因果影响。禀赋和卷烟价格的变化是识别的来源。我们证明教育可以减少吸烟。一项反事实实验发现，在不吸烟的情况下，人口中的大学入学率会增加 2 个百分点。另一种附加消费税 25% 也取得了类似的结果。对于不同认知和非认知能力的人来说，影响有很大差异。

articles.title_cn: 算法设计：公平性-准确性前沿
articles.abstract_en: Algorithm designers increasingly care not only about accuracy but also about fairness across predefined groups. We study the trade-off between these objectives and characterize it by a fairness-accuracy frontier: the set of outcomes that cannot be simultaneously improved in both dimensions. The shape of this frontier is governed by a simple property of the inputs, which we call group skew. In particular, reducing accuracy for both groups to increase fairness is justified if and only if inputs are group skewed. We also study an information design problem in which a designer regulates inputs but another agent chooses the algorithm. We show that, when inputs are not group skewed, banning group identity or other informative inputs is strictly suboptimal.
articles.abstract_cn: 算法设计者不仅越来越关心准确性，而且越来越关心预定义组之间的公平性。我们研究这些目标之间的权衡，并用公平-准确边界来表征它：一组不能在两个维度上同时改进的结果。该边界的形状由输入的一个简单属性控制，我们称之为组偏斜。特别是，当且仅当输入存在群体偏差时，降低两个群体的准确性以提高公平性才是合理的。我们还研究了一个信息设计问题，其中设计者调节输入，但另一个代理选择算法。我们表明，当输入不存在群体偏差时，禁止群体身份或其他信息输入严格来说是次优的。

articles.title_en: Booms, Busts, and Mismatch in Capital Markets: Evidence from the Offshore Oil and Gas Industry
articles.title_cn: 资本市场的繁荣、萧条和错配：来自海上石油和天然气行业的证据
articles.abstract_en: How efficiently do markets reallocate capital in booms and busts? Using a novel dataset of offshore drilling contracts, I examine the role of matching in shaping industry reallocation. Oil companies search and match with capital (rigs) in a decentralized market. I find that oil and gas booms increase the option value of searching, which leads agents to avoid bad matches, reducing mismatch through a sorting effect. I provide an identification strategy to disentangle unobserved demand changes from the sorting effect. Estimating a model, I find substantial benefits to the sorting effect and an intermediary, but I find that demand-smoothing policies are ineffective.
articles.abstract_cn: 市场在繁荣和萧条时期重新配置资本的效率如何？我使用海上钻井合同的新颖数据集，研究了匹配在塑造行业重新分配中的作用。石油公司在分散的市场中寻找并匹配资本（钻机）。我发现石油和天然气的繁荣增加了搜索的选项价值，这导致代理避免不良匹配，通过排序效应减少不匹配。我提供了一种识别策略，将未观察到的需求变化与排序效应分开。在估计模型时，我发现排序效应和中介有很大的好处，但我发现需求平滑政策是无效的。

articles.title_en: US Public Debt and Safe Asset Market Power
articles.title_cn: 美国公共债务和安全资产市场力量
articles.abstract_en: The US government is the dominant supplier of global safe assets and faces a downward-sloping demand for its debt. We develop a model of the global economy in which US public debt generates special value for holders, endowing the US government with market power. We use variations in demand elasticities during high- and low-volatility regimes to distinguish this model from a price-taking benchmark and find that the data reject price-taking behavior in favor of the US government exploiting market power. We quantify the distortions, finding significant underprovision of safe assets, convenience yield markups, and welfare benefits for the United States.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国政府是全球安全资产的主要供应者，其债务需求面临下滑。我们开发了一个全球经济模型，其中美国公共债务为持有人创造特殊价值，赋予美国政府市场力量。我们利用高波动率和低波动率期间需求弹性的变化来区分该模型与定价基准，并发现数据拒绝有利于美国政府利用市场力量的定价行为。我们对扭曲进行了量化，发现美国的安全资产、便利收益率加成和福利待遇严重不足。

articles.abstract_en: Private signals model noisy information about an unknown state. Although these signals are called private, they may still carry information about each other. Our paper introduces the concept of private private signals, which contain information about the state but not about other signals. To achieve privacy, signal quality may need to be sacrificed. We study the informativeness of private private signals and characterize those that are optimal in the sense that they cannot be made more informative without violating privacy. We discuss implications for privacy in recommendation systems, information design, causal inference, and mechanism design.
articles.abstract_cn: 私有信号对未知状态的噪声信息进行建模。尽管这些信号被称为私有信号，但它们仍然可能携带有关彼此的信息。我们的论文介绍了私有私有信号的概念，它包含有关状态的信息，但不包含有关其他信号的信息。为了实现隐私，可能需要牺牲信号质量。我们研究私人信号的信息量，并描述那些最佳的信号，因为它们不能在不侵犯隐私的情况下提供更多信息。我们讨论推荐系统、信息设计、因果推理和机制设计对隐私的影响。
